Remark
[Cartan formalism for Killing-form metrics]

Source: petersen:page-0132 ↗ rem:pet-ch3-ex-33

1. ch3:3.4.34Using the Cartan formalism of section 3 in the setting of section 3, compute all quantities in terms of the structure constants of $\mathfrak g$: with a biinvariant metric, in an orthonormal basis they satisfy $c^k_{ij}=-c^k_{ji}=c^i_{jk}$, the first equality being skew-symmetry of the bracket, the second biinvariance of the metric.
